svg.title: sparse-prefill
svg.desc: Three per-head prefill patterns from MInference on toy 32×32 masks: A-shape (static first columns plus local band; real 1,024 + 4,096), Vertical-Slash (columns and diagonals estimated from the last 64 queries), Block-Sparse (64×64 blocks scored by mean-pooled q and k, top 100 kept). XAttention scores each block by the sum of its antidiagonal cells and keeps the fewest blocks whose softmax mass passes a threshold: 6.89% density at 128K with stride 8. Reported: 1M-token prefill on one A100 from 30 to 3 minutes; Qwen2.5-1M 3–7× prefill speedup at 1M.
